description: This file attaches behaviors for the Drupal Comment module's 'X new comments' link, managing the display and update of new comment indicators via DOM manipulation and AJAX requests.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides a 'new comment' element by modifying DOM classes and visibility.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a 'new comment' element from DOM after hiding it.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Shows a 'new comment' element by modifying DOM classes and visibility.

methods.name: processNodeNewCommentLinks
methods.description: Processes placeholders for new comment links, determines which need updates, and renders or removes them accordingly.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the 'X new comments' links based on AJAX results or embedded data.
